credential_fields.label: Bedrock Mantle API Key
credential_fields.tooltip: Bearer token for the Bedrock Mantle OpenAI-compatible endpoint. You can provide the raw token or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/BEDROCK_MANTLE_API_KEY`). Leave blank to authenticate with AWS SigV4 credentials instead.

credential_fields.label: AWS Access Key ID
credential_fields.tooltip: Used for AWS SigV4 auth when no API key is set. You can provide the raw key or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/MY_SECRET_KEY`).

credential_fields.label: AWS Secret Access Key
credential_fields.tooltip: Used for AWS SigV4 auth when no API key is set. You can provide the raw key or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/MY_SECRET_KEY`).

credential_fields.label: AWS Session Token
credential_fields.tooltip: Temporary credentials session token. You can provide the raw token or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/MY_SESSION_TOKEN`).

credential_fields.label: AWS Region Name
credential_fields.tooltip: Region of the Bedrock Mantle endpoint. Defaults to us-east-1. You can provide the raw value or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/AWS_REGION_NAME`).

credential_fields.label: AWS Session Name
credential_fields.tooltip: Name for the AWS session. You can provide the raw value or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/MY_SESSION_NAME`).

credential_fields.label: AWS Profile Name
credential_fields.tooltip: AWS profile name to use for authentication. You can provide the raw value or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/MY_PROFILE_NAME`).

credential_fields.label: AWS Role Name
credential_fields.tooltip: AWS IAM role name to assume. You can provide the raw value or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/MY_ROLE_NAME`).

credential_fields.label: AWS Web Identity Token
credential_fields.tooltip: Web identity token for OIDC authentication. You can provide the raw token or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/MY_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN`).

credential_fields.label: API Base
credential_fields.tooltip: Optional. Custom Bedrock Mantle endpoint. Defaults to https://bedrock-mantle.<region>.api.aws. You can provide the raw value or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/BEDROCK_MANTLE_API_BASE`).

credential_fields.label: Upstream API Base
credential_fields.tooltip: Optional. Where the proxy forwards requests upstream. Leave blank to use Anthropic's public API. Set this only for private Anthropic deployments or reverse proxies. Do NOT set this to your LiteLLM proxy URL — that causes a recursive loop.

credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.tooltip: Leave empty for BYOK (bring-your-own-key) flows, where clients forward their own Anthropic key via the x-api-key header. Requires the 'Forward LLM provider auth headers' UI setting to be enabled.

credential_fields.label: AWS Access Key ID
credential_fields.tooltip: You can provide the raw key or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/MY_SECRET_KEY`).

credential_fields.label: AWS Secret Access Key
credential_fields.tooltip: You can provide the raw key or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/MY_SECRET_KEY`).

credential_fields.label: AWS Region Name
credential_fields.tooltip: You can provide the raw key or the environment variable (e.g. `os.environ/MY_SECRET_KEY`).

credential_fields.label: API Version
credential_fields.tooltip: By default litellm will use the latest version. If you want to use a different version, you can specify it here

credential_fields.label: Tenant ID
credential_fields.placeholder: Enter your Azure AD tenant ID
credential_fields.tooltip: Entra ID (Service Principal) auth. Provide tenant id, client id, and client secret together as an alternative to api key.

credential_fields.label: Client ID
credential_fields.placeholder: Enter your Service Principal client ID
credential_fields.tooltip: Entra ID (Service Principal) auth. Provide tenant id, client id, and client secret together as an alternative to api key.

credential_fields.label: Client Secret
credential_fields.placeholder: Enter your Service Principal client secret
credential_fields.tooltip: Entra ID (Service Principal) auth. Provide tenant id, client id, and client secret together as an alternative to api key.

credential_fields.label: API Base
credential_fields.tooltip: Enter your full Target URI from Azure Foundry here. Example:  https://litellm8397336933.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/gpt-4o/chat/completions?api-version=2024-10-21
